transcript: You cannot be afraid of what's on the other side. In order to pivot through seasons, in order to transition into a different life, a more full life, a fuller version of yourself, you have to be willing to let it all go, release everything that you know, deconstruct everything that you know, in order to allow your future self to meet you where you are. There is no need to pressure yourself, there is no need to rush timing, but you have to be willing to remove fear and move in something that is unfamiliar. It is okay to fail, it is okay to fall, but it is not okay to sit and allow life to pass you by without making any movement.
